source: Avalanche Canada Mountain Information Network (public reports)

reports.title: Healy Pass, Banff NP
reports.comment: quick: Very thin coverage from Sunshine parking lot but quickly improved with elevation. 130cm+ base at pass with about 30cm+ of new snow on a supportive crust. Temps for the day -8C from parking lot, -9C at the pass, -3C back at parking lot at 3pm. Everything stable with no signs of natural avalanche activity.

reports.title: Flow Lake area
reports.comment: avalanche: The faceted surface layers are were sluffing very hard and fast in the burns. Starting in steeper tree'd terrain, but then gathering momentum and snow and running far, mid path. Class 1 to 2's observed today

reports.title: Healy Pass/ Monarch Ramparts
reports.comment: quick: Weekend at Healy Pass area - new snow Feb 25 made for some great skiing off of Monarch Ramparts. Quite a bit of variability but some powder to be found. Skied 35-40 degree slopes Feb 24 and found no signs of instability but rode some pretty variable hardpacked snow with pockets of powder from wind transfer. That all changed the next day with 10-15cm of new snow on Feb 25 - some excellent sk…

reports.title: South Twins and Rock Isle
reports.comment:
quick: Found less then ideal conditions on east facing slopes with a 5cm hard crust buried below 8-10cm for new storm snow in the morning.
We moved over to Northfacing slopes in the afternoon and found 20-30cms of storm snow which made for excellent conditions. 
No recent activity was seen. Temperature stayed relatively stable at around -5 to 0 degrees all day.
